codeReview.summary: The build-and-cleanup feature is a large, well-executed cleanup commit (106 files changed, -18,505 lines removed). It removes all legacy vanilla JS (src/js/), CSS (src/css/), SVG icons (src/icons/), and legacy HTML entry points (start.html, promotion.html) that have been fully replaced by React/TypeScript/Tailwind equivalents. The ESLint config was properly migrated to typescript-eslint. Prettier was run across the codebase. Lint errors were fixed (prefer-const, unused catch binding, stale eslint-disable directives). AGENTS.md was updated to reflect the new React SPA architecture. Dist-helper launcher scripts were updated to reference only index.html. All validators pass: tsc (0 errors), eslint (0 errors), vitest (618 tests, 21 files), and npm run build (3.86s, working dist/). No active code references to deleted legacy paths remain.

The Pages table lists '/start.html' and '/promotion.html' URLs. The Architecture section describes 'Three HTML entry points' and lists src/js/ module paths. The Project Structure tree shows src/js/ and src/css/ directories. The feature description says 'Update any remaining references to old file paths' but README.md was not updated.

Includes outdated sections like 'Architecture Overview', 'Core Source Layout', 'File Structure', and development instructions referencing src/js/templates.js, src/js/ui.js, etc.
docs/ARCHITECTURE-MAP.md still describes the old architecture scoped to 'source modules under src/js/' and HTML entry points. All module descriptions reference src/js/ paths.

AGENTS.md NOTES section says '700 tests' but the actual count is now 618 after removing 2 legacy test files (start-app.test.js, theme.test.js with 82 tests). This was updated in the handoff but not in AGENTS.md.
Build produces a 680KB JS chunk (208KB gzipped) exceeding Vite's 500KB warning threshold. Consider React.lazy() for route-level code splitting or manualChunks for vendor libraries.

summary: The build-and-cleanup feature passes. It successfully removes all legacy vanilla JS (src/js/), CSS (src/css/), SVG icons (src/icons/), and HTML entry points (start.html, promotion.html) — totaling 18,505 lines removed. ESLint was migrated to typescript-eslint, prettier formatting was applied, and lint errors were fixed. All validators pass cleanly: tsc (0 errors), eslint (0 errors), vitest (618 tests, 21 files), and npm run build (working dist/ in 3.86s). No active code imports or references to deleted paths remain in src/ or tests/. Non-blocking issues: README.md, docs/README.md, and docs/ARCHITECTURE-MAP.md were not updated to reflect the React SPA migration and still reference the old multi-page architecture. AGENTS.md has a stale test count (700 vs actual 618). These are documentation-only gaps that don't affect build or runtime behavior.
